summary.text: Jeff Raatz is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 27 since November 2014 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as educator.

paragraphs.text: Raatz earned a bachelor's degree in business from Baker College of Muskegon, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as an educator; he is the principal of Richmond Academy and a part-time program coordinator at Miami University.
Raatz assumed office in the state Senate on November 5, 2014.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Education and Career Development Committee and is also assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
